questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki treats a patient affiliated with the CNSS (private sector). According to Law 65-00, which body manages the AMO for this patient?
questions.explanation: The CNSS (National Social Security Fund) manages the AMO for the private sector, while the CNOPS manages it for the public sector.

questions.question: Dr. Alami treats a civil servant. According to Law 65-00, which body manages the AMO for this patient?
questions.explanation: The CNOPS (National Fund of Social Welfare Organizations) manages the AMO for civil servants and agents of the State, local authorities, and public establishments.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, what is the Compulsory Health Insurance (AMO)?
options: A mandatory basic health insurance based on the contributory principle
An assistance scheme only for underprivileged people
An insurance reserved only for civil servants
questions.explanation: The AMO is a mandatory basic health insurance, based on the contributory principle and risk pooling, established by Law 65-00.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who has no AMO coverage and cannot pay their contributions. According to Law 65-00, which scheme can they benefit from?
options: No scheme, they must pay for their care
questions.explanation: In addition to the AMO, Law 65-00 establishes a medical assistance scheme (RAMED) based on national solidarity for economically disadvantaged people.

questions.question: Dr. Alami treats a patient affiliated with a mutual insurance company. What is the main role of this mutual insurance company in relation to the AMO?
options: It provides complementary coverage to the AMO
It manages the AMO for the public sector
It is mandatory for all patients
questions.explanation: Mutual insurance companies play a role of complementary coverage, increasing reimbursement rates or expanding the list of covered care.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, which type of procedure is excluded from the scope of benefits guaranteed by the AMO?
questions.explanation: Law 65-00 excludes cosmetic surgery procedures, spa treatments, acupuncture, mesotherapy, thalassotherapy, homeopathy, and alternative medicine.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki proposes teeth whitening treatment to a patient. Will this treatment be covered by the AMO?
options: No, because whitening is a cosmetic procedure
Yes, if the dentist prescribes it
questions.explanation: Cosmetic surgery procedures are excluded from benefits guaranteed by the AMO. Since teeth whitening is a cosmetic procedure, it is not reimbursed.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, who are the dependents covered by the AMO?
options: The spouse and parents of the insured
The spouse and dependent children up to age 21
Dependent children up to age 30 without conditions
All family members without age limit
questions.explanation: The covered dependents are the spouse(s) and dependent children aged 21 or under, except for unmarried children pursuing higher education up to age 30 according to Law 54.23.

questions.question: Dr. Alami treats a patient whose children are 25 years old and pursuing higher education. According to Law 54.23, are these children covered by the AMO?
options: No, because they have exceeded 21 years
No, because they must be independent
questions.explanation: Law 54.23 extended the coverage age for unmarried students pursuing their studies up to age 30, instead of 26.

questions.question: According to Article 5 of Law 65-00, how is a disabled child covered by the AMO?
questions.explanation: Dependent disabled children benefit from AMO coverage without age limit.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who wants to get a dental implant. According to AMO rules, is this treatment covered?
options: No, dental implants are not covered by the AMO
Yes, if the patient has a mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: Dental implants, aesthetic veneers, or ceramic-ceramic crowns are generally not covered by the AMO, which only reimburses basic care.

questions.question: According to Law 54.23, which is the single body that will manage the AMO in the future?
questions.explanation: The draft law 54.23 provides for entrusting the management of the basic AMO scheme to a single body, the National Social Security Fund (CNSS).

questions.question: Dr. Alami treats a student patient. According to Law 54.23, what does the new law provide for the AMO scheme for students?
options: It is abolished and students are transferred to other schemes
It is managed by the CNOPS
questions.explanation: Law 54.23 abolishes the specific AMO scheme for students as an autonomous scheme. Students now benefit from coverage as dependents or through other mechanisms.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, what is the reimbursement rate for a consultation with a general practitioner under the AMO?
questions.explanation: The AMO generally reimburses 80% of the National Reference Tariff (TNR) for consultations and basic care, with the remainder being the patient's responsibility.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki treats a patient who has complementary mutual insurance. How is the reimbursement distribution done?
options: The mutual insurance company reimburses 80%, the AMO the rest
The AMO reimburses 80%, the mutual insurance company covers the rest
The mutual insurance company reimburses 100% without AMO intervention
The patient chooses which body pays
questions.explanation: The AMO reimburses 80% of the National Reference Tariff, then the complementary mutual insurance covers all or part of the co-payment.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, what basic dental care is covered by the AMO?
questions.explanation: The AMO covers consultations, caries treatment, extractions, and conservative treatments, but not prostheses or implants.

questions.question: Dr. Alami must perform a prosthetic bridge on a patient. According to AMO rules, what procedure should be followed?
options: The patient can start treatment without formalities
The dentist must first perform the treatment and then request reimbursement
The AMO does not reimburse any prostheses
questions.explanation: Benefits such as dental prostheses or orthodontics require a prior agreement: a detailed quote must be sent to the relevant body before starting treatment.

questions.question: According to Article 114 of Law 65-00, under what conditions can employers replace the AMO with a mutual insurance company?
options: Yes, provided that the benefits are at least equivalent to the AMO
Yes, if the employer pays higher contributions
questions.explanation: Article 114 of Law 65-00 allows, on a transitional basis, public or private bodies to maintain optional medical coverage, provided that the benefits are at least equivalent to those of the AMO.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who has a dental care invoice. What is the maximum deadline for submitting a reimbursement request?
questions.explanation: Documents must be submitted within the deadlines set by the body, often within 60 days following the date of care.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, what is the 'co-payment' for an AMO patient?
options: The amount the patient pays after AMO reimbursement
The amount reimbursed by the mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: The co-payment is the portion remaining the responsibility of the insured after AMO reimbursement, generally 20% of the National Reference Tariff.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, are workplace accidents covered by the AMO?
options: No, they are governed by specific legislation
Yes, but only for civil servants
questions.explanation: Law 65-00 specifies that risks related to workplace accidents and occupational diseases remain governed by specific legislation and regulations.

questions.question: Dr. Alami treats a patient who has an internal mutual insurance company at their company. According to the developments of Law 54.23, what happens to these agreements?
options: They remain in force for a transitional period
They become the only possible coverage
They are automatically taken over by the CNSS
questions.explanation: Agreements concluded with mutual insurance companies remain in force for a duration to be set by decree, as part of the transition to the unified system.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, what benefits are guaranteed by the AMO?
options: Preventive and curative care, maternity, rehabilitation, and dental care
Only care related to workplace accidents
questions.explanation: The AMO guarantees coverage for risks and care costs related to illness, maternity, rehabilitation, including preventive and curative care, and dental care.

questions.question: Dr. Mabrouki has a patient who wants aesthetic veneers. According to Law 65-00, how are these procedures covered?
options: They are excluded from the scope of the AMO as cosmetic procedures
At 100% if the dentist prescribes them
Partially depending on the mutual insurance company
questions.explanation: Cosmetic surgery procedures, including aesthetic veneers, are excluded from the scope of benefits guaranteed by the AMO.

questions.question: According to Law 65-00, who is considered a 'dependent' of the AMO insured?
questions.explanation: Dependents are the spouse(s) and dependent children of the insured, in accordance with Law 65-00.
